meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以载入代谢模型，执行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除模拟，以及计算最小培养基等，并以数字或图表形式给出结果。
howto.when: 当您要求进行代谢建模、通量分析、基因敲除或优化培养基时触发，例如提到“FBA”、“代谢模型”或“最小培养基”等关键词。

say.note: 返回生长速率和各反应通量。

say.text: 计算给定模型的最小培养基

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load metabolic models, perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout simulations, and compute minimal media, returning numerical or graphical results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for metabolic modeling, flux analysis, gene knockouts, or media optimization, e.g., mentioning "FBA", "metabolic model", or "minimal medium".

say_en.text: Run a standard FBA on the textbook model.
Compute minimal medium for a given model.
